title: Iconic 49ers RB Roger Craig announces he has vascular dementia during Hall of Fame speech: 'This diagnosis doesn't define me'

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Iconic 49ers RB Roger Craig announces he has vascular dementia during Hall of Fame speech: 'This diagnosis doesn't define me'
sources.description: Craig said his doctors believe the dementia may be related, at least in part, to the concussions he suffered during his 11-season NFL career.
